name: 28BYJ-48 stepper mount (L bracket)
source: 28BYJ-48 datasheet (35 mm ear spacing, 4.2 mm slots) via https://components101.com/motors/28byj-48-stepper-motor
notes: Flat plate 3 mm thick with a 12 mm tall back wall (y 0-3). The 28BYJ-48's two ears (35 mm apart) bolt to m1/m2 with M4 screws; place the stepper at (8, 4, 3) so its ear holes line up. Wall holes foot1/foot2 point along Y (z=6) for M3 screws into a panel.
